description: Worklog/timesheet policy checker - run a batch of worklog entries through configurable guardrails BEFORE posting them to a time-tracking system. Checks: rounding increment (default 0.25h, float-safe), per-entry min/max, per-author daily totals, duplicates, over-estimate alerts (never suggests inflating hours or estimates - flags to PM instead), future dates, weekends, immutable-author edit protection, missing description/ticket. Returns pass/warnings/blocked verdict + per-entry violations with fixes + hour totals by author and date. Caller supplies the reference date - fully deterministic, no LLM.

entries.description: Up to 500: [{author, date "YYYY-MM-DD", hours, ticket?, description?, estimate_hours?, already_logged_hours?, id?, edit?, delete?, new?}].

policy.description: Optional overrides: rounding_increment, max_hours_per_day, max_hours_per_entry, min_hours_per_entry, immutable_authors, require_description, require_ticket, over_estimate_policy (alert|block|ignore), future_dates (block|alert), weekend_policy (allow|alert).

name: worklog_guardrail
